clause: Cross-document style transfer + export tag mapping [STU-LAY-040,STU-LAY-041]

scope.summary: Implement cross-document style transfer: load selected styles from another document with per-style conflict resolution (use-incoming vs auto-rename) and incoming word-processor style mapping on import with saved presets. Implement export tag mapping: each text and object style declares an export tag and class (for reflowable/HTML export) plus a tagged-PDF role, editable singly or in bulk; stored on the style record in StudioStyleRegistry; drives accessible/tagged output (MT-187) and reflowable export via 14.11.
acceptance_criteria: cross-document style load with conflict resolution + WP mapping presets; export tag/class/PDF-role editable singly + bulk
proof_targets: cross-doc transfer conflict-resolution runtime; export-tag bulk-edit test
expected_tests: live: load styles from another document with use-incoming/auto-rename conflict resolution + WP style mapping preset
test: export tag/class + tagged-PDF role editable singly and in bulk, stored on style record

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Sharing styles & export tagging

risk_if_missed: Styles cannot move between documents; accessible/tagged and reflowable export lack style-to-tag mapping.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
